name: @sos-2/greenfield-harness
description: SOS 2.0 Greenfield harness (Work Order W14): a runnable end-to-end harness executing the greenfield pipeline on a golden demo scenario — deterministic (fixed inputs, fixed seed, byte-identical outputs across runs, snapshot-tested including the trace graph), printing the mission -> candidate -> decision -> realization -> reconciliation -> evidence summary and exiting 0 only if every stage succeeded and the trace chain is complete. Zero domain logic of its own: everything is imported from @sos-2/*.
